caption_used: Календарно изгладени базисни индекси на произведените лекарствени вещества и продукти в България (2021=100), представени по месеци за три години — 2022, 2023 и 2024. Индексите за 2023 г. показват най-високи стойности сред трите години, особено през месеците юни и октомври, където надвишават 105%. Годината 2022 демонстрира най-изразена сезонна вариация с пик от около 128% през декември, докато 2024 г. се характеризира с умерени стойности, достигащи максимум приблизително 95% през март.
raw_response:
The figure is a column chart illustrating calendar-smoothed base indices of pharmaceutical substances and products produced in Bulgaria over three years: 2022, 2023, and 2024. The chart represents these indices monthly, from January (I) to December (XII), and the values are expressed as percentages relative to a 2021 baseline, with 2021 set as 100. The horizontal axis represents the months of the year, arranged in chronological order from I to XII. The vertical axis displays the index values, ranging from 0,000 to 140,000, with increments of 20,000. The scale is linear, and the axis is labeled "месеци" (months). Three data series are presented, each with a distinct color: a blue series representing 2022, an orange series representing 2023, and a gray series representing 2024. The blue series exhibits a noticeable peak in December 2022, reaching approximately 128%, and displays a general downward trend throughout the year, with the lowest value observed in January 2022. The orange series shows the highest overall values across the three years, with a peak in June and October 2023 exceeding 105%. The gray series demonstrates a more consistent and moderate trend, reaching a maximum of approximately 95% in March 2024. The height of each column corresponds to the index value for the respective month and year.  The columns are not ordered in any particular sequence.
